name: kelpie
description: Delegation policy for Claude Code, cut down to what its own benchmark supports: four pinned roles, a skill that argues against delegating at your own model's price, and a hook that checks every prompt for work a cheaper model can do for less.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key
jev_api_key.description: A key from console.typesafe.ai/keys for TypeSafe AI's Jev. It turns on the spawn gate, which sends an excerpt of each file named in a gated Workflow call (up to 120 lines or 6000 characters) plus its path; files outside the working directory are never read or sent. It sends no prompts on its own: that takes the Send prompts to Jev option as well. Without a key kelpie decides from keywords and sends nothing.

jev_send_prompts.title: Send prompts to Jev
jev_send_prompts.description: Off unless you turn it on, and needs the Jev API key. On, kelpie sends the text of every prompt its delegation triage reads to api.typesafe.ai before the turn starts, and uses the answer to decide whether a subagent on a cheaper model can do the work for less than your session. Slash commands and the notices Claude Code generates itself, such as the reports subagents hand back, are never sent. Off, the triage decides from keywords and no prompt leaves your machine.
